import os
import re
import datetime as dt
import openpyxl

input_path = "/mnt/data/spreadsheet/368-44/1_368-44_input.xlsx"
output_path = "/mnt/data/outputs/368-44_0_38135fe9/1_368-44_output.xlsx"

wb = openpyxl.load_workbook(input_path)
ws = wb["Sheet1"]

def time_to_hhmm(value):
    """Convert Excel/openpyxl time-like values to text HHMM, e.g. 10:14:00 -> 1014."""
    if value is None or value == "":
        return None

    if isinstance(value, dt.datetime):
        return f"{value.hour:02d}{value.minute:02d}"

    if isinstance(value, dt.time):
        return f"{value.hour:02d}{value.minute:02d}"

    if isinstance(value, (int, float)):
        # Excel stores times as fractions of a day.
        if 0 <= value < 1:
            total_minutes = int(round(value * 24 * 60)) % (24 * 60)
            hour = total_minutes // 60
            minute = total_minutes % 60
            return f"{hour:02d}{minute:02d}"
        text = str(int(value)) if float(value).is_integer() else str(value)
        return text.zfill(4) if text.isdigit() and len(text) <= 4 else text

    text = str(value).strip()
    match = re.search(r"(\d{1,2}):(\d{2})(?::\d{2})?", text)
    if match:
        return f"{int(match.group(1)):02d}{int(match.group(2)):02d}"

    digits = re.sub(r"\D", "", text)
    if digits and len(digits) <= 4:
        return digits.zfill(4)

    return text

# Only modify the allowed answer range: G2:J10.
for row in range(2, 11):
    # Keep existing extracted Date and EmployeeName values in G:H.
    if ws.cell(row=row, column=7).value is not None:
        ws.cell(row=row, column=7).number_format = "yyyy-mm-dd"

    # Convert Clock In / Clock Out in I:J to literal HHMM text without colons.
    for col in (9, 10):
        cell = ws.cell(row=row, column=col)
        converted = time_to_hhmm(cell.value)
        cell.value = converted
        cell.number_format = "@"

os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(output_path), exist_ok=True)
wb.save(output_path)
